newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: TAG Heuer announces note tender.
newsitem.headline: TAG Heuer announces note tender.

text.p: TAG Heuer International SA, the Swiss-based watch company, said it has begun a tender offer for all of its outstanding 12 percent senior subordinated notes due 2005.
There is currently $71.5 million outstanding in the notes. The offer will expire at midnight, New York City time (0400 GMT) July 24 unless extended, the company said.

Morgan Stanley Dean Witter is acting as dealer manager and solicitation agent for the tender offer. MacKenzie Partners, Inc is serving as information agent, TAG Heuer said. -- Zurich Editorial, +41 1 631 7340
